predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: All180 attempts retained. Candidate requires complete90-call arm denominators, primary-hit@5 mean gain>=0.10, one-sided exact sign-test p<0.05 over30 paired-query means with ties excluded (all ties p=1), usable rate>=baseline-0.02, p95<=30s and<=2*baseline p95. Native latency includes failures; absent latency prevents gate pass. MRR and uniqueness secondary only. Missing named scores on provider errors become zeros, never omissions. p95 nearest rank ceil(.95*n). No win retains incumbent within this corpus, not equivalence.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: No token-savings claim. Provider tokens and hidden engine retries remain unknown; preserve native returned usage and distinguish any native zero counter from whole-task usage.

limitations: Source-family retrieval proxy on software documentation corpus; does not qualify answer/citation truth, whole research quality, skill/MCP/HTTP gates or host readiness.
q27 is ambiguous and has a broad official-doc target; source-topic branch aliases do not prove version accuracy.
DeerFlow's normalized SearXNG results omit per-engine diagnostics; unavailable counters stay unknown. Keyed arms excluded.
Failures/empty output can make baseline latency low; the preregistered relative p95 gate still applies.

Eighteen schema arm views refer to nine shared CLI processes, counted once by command_index. All process grading exits100 are preserved and aggregate quality remains null; this does not turn the180 native tool calls into18 independent experiments or assign provider subprocess exits.

Native response cachefalse does not establish engine/index independence. Seventy-two SearXNG calls return valid empty lists; no provider-error objects/missing native named metrics occur in this trial.
Source-family URL discovery is not answer/citation truth or version-specific content validation.
Thirty query pairs are the statistical units; repeats share engines/indexes/caches, and nominal p is scoped to this fixed corpus.
DDGS9.14.1 backendauto is the unchanged current multi-engine baseline; no pure-DDG or keyed-provider claim.
Upstream default persistent SearXNG engines/settings were frozen; normalized tool results omit per-query engine diagnostics/retries.
Exact-string distinctness is not canonical duplicate suppression.
q27 is ambiguous and broad official workflow-doc matches do not prove its cache-mode phrase.
Strict paper-window hold separated round3-batch1 from the final two batches; native batch timestamps are retained, no per-call timestamp invented.
Any owner-row or provider adoption remains with the command center; measurement changes no host plan.
